# Signet Artists

> Signet Artists delivers music for your event in Denver, Colorado and surrounding areas. A variety of genre's and configurations are available to book - effortlessly. All sized to your event and budget, for private events across Colorado. Enjoy one contract and one point of contact for the night. Send us the date and the venue - we take care of  the rest.

Signet Artists is a live music company for private events in Denver, the Front Range, and the mountain corridor. No prices are published: what the pricing page carries is what live music costs in this market, each figure with the source it came from, and a night is priced when a date is checked.

## Credits

Trusted and booked by Amazon, NBCUniversal, Charles Schwab, Kroger, Denver Art Museum, Sheraton, Hyatt, Washington Nationals, Casa Bonita and Monarch Casino Resort Spa Black Hawk. Also Live Nation, Valley Country Club and the National Cherry Blossom Festival, and the stages at Dazzle, the Bluebird Theater, Cervantes, the 9:30 Club and many, many more.

## Acts

- Tejas Singh (Singer-songwriter covers, fronted by Tejas Singh): Authentic and intimate with a specialty in building familiar songs from the ground up with his amazing ear and technology, Tejas brings a wide variety of fan favorite songs and is also available to play his original, singer-songwriter material to your event. Configurations: Duo to quartet. https://signetartists.com/artists/tejas-singh/
- Jazz Duo (Jazz standards, Upright bass and guitar): Jazz standards on upright bass and guitar, bring immediate class to a cocktail hour or special event. The Signet Jazz duo specializes in music for when guests arrive, sip cocktails or enjoy dinner. This act is the perfect glue for special evenings when music holds the night together effortlessly, and the volume and genre sit perfectly under riveting conversations. Configurations: Duo to trio. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/jazz-duo-trio/
- Dirty Flamenco (Flamenco, fronted by Gary Meyers): Brilliant, guitar-based flamenco musical act and one of the only ones in Colorado available for private event bookings. Dirty flamenco plays real palos, and rhumba both authentically and with a soulful twist. They are a polished, working group with an extensive standing repertoire. Configurations: Trio, larger by request. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/flamenco-trio/
- Funk Trio (Funk and soul, Guitar, bass, drums, with voice): Funk and soul covers at trio size, for a party where the dance floor is close to the tables. The songs a crowd already knows, played by three people who can fill a floor without needing a stage to do it. Two working trios sit behind this format, which is why it holds a Saturday. Configurations: Trio. https://signetartists.com/music/
- DJ (Open format, Decks, and a PA sized to the venue): Open format, on its own or carrying the late end after a band steps off. Through the same sound system, run by the same team, on the same contract. The most common single booking of the corporate season. Configurations: On its own, or with a live player. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/dj/
- Blues Rock (Blues, rock and roots, One voice and a guitar, or two): Blues rock covers, solo or as a duo, at the smallest spend on this roster. Real playing rather than a playlist, at whatever volume the venue will take. Rehearsal dinners, welcome drinks, office parties, and any event where live music is the right idea and a band is the wrong size. Configurations: Solo to duo. https://signetartists.com/music/
- Last Consulate (Instrumental downtempo, Upright bass, guitar and electronics, one player): One player, upright bass out front, over downtempo electronics with slow hip-hop drums, worn keys and delayed guitar. Jazz improvisation on top, at conversation volume. Arrival, cocktails and dinner, on original material that sounds closer to an early-2000s downtempo record than to a jazz set. Configurations: Solo. https://signetartists.com/music/

## Pricing

Signet Artists publishes no price list, no starting prices and no hourly figures. Actual prices vary by date, size, hours and location. https://signetartists.com/pricing/ sets out what live music costs in this market, with each figure attributed to the public source it came from, so a budget can be set before anyone writes. To get the number for a specific night, send the date: https://signetartists.com/contact/

Travel beyond the Denver metro, a night's lodging past the passes, holiday weekends and New Year's Eve are quoted as their own lines rather than folded into a headline figure.
